card.text: TOI-5734 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-5734 b"
sources.quote: TOI-5734 b is a confirmed exoplanet orbiting the young orange dwarf star TOI-5734, a K3-K4 spectral class star, at a distance of approximately 106 light-years from the Sun.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-5734. Its orbit and size follow Filomeno et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-5734 b"
sources.quote: The discovery of the object was officially announced by an international team of astronomers led by Simone Filomeno in late February 2026.
